Cookie Policy

Last updated: February 2026

What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit websites. They help websites remember your preferences and improve your experience.

How We Use Cookies

DevSolve uses minimal cookies for essential functionality:

Essential Cookies

  • Theme preference: Remembers your light/dark mode choice

Analytics Cookies (Optional)

If enabled, we may use basic analytics to understand how our tools are used. These do not track personal information.

Local Storage

We also use browser local storage for:

  • User preferences (theme settings)
  • Optional local analytics data

Local storage data stays on your device and is not transmitted to our servers.

Third-Party Cookies

When you click links to external services, those sites may set their own cookies. We do not control third-party cookies.

Managing Cookies

You can control cookies through your browser settings:

  • Block all cookies
  • Delete existing cookies
  • Allow cookies from specific sites only

Our tools will continue to function if you disable cookies, though your preferences may not be saved between visits.

Clearing Local Storage

To clear local storage data:

  1. Open your browser's developer tools (F12)
  2. Go to the Application or Storage tab
  3. Find Local Storage and clear the data for this site

Changes to This Policy

We may update this cookie policy as needed. Check this page for the latest information.

Contact

For questions about our cookie practices, please contact us through our website.
